method: Visually inspected decoded MP4 frames extracted at one-second intervals; matched steady holds against original frame timestamps.
observations: At approximately 5–7 and 11–13 seconds the solid block visibly covers the first e immediately after QA>; at 8–10 and 19–21 seconds it is after two. Each state holds steadily for about three seconds.
At 35–41 seconds Option+Shift+[ and ] visibly switch between TERMINAL TWO and TERMINAL THREE, with the selected tab highlight changing.
At 41–47 seconds Cmd+Shift+Left/Right visibly swaps the solid active cursor and hollow inactive cursor between panes.
At 47–54 seconds Cmd+Option+Shift+Left/Right visibly moves TERMINAL THREE and its selected tab to the left pane and back right.
After tab movement the remounted terminal returns to its thin blinking cursor; its heading and tab placement still clearly show the move.
